notes.title: Reality Break has officially launched!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone!![/h3]
Today, I am thrilled to release Reality Break, my sci-fi Action RPG Roguelite! I have been working on this game for several years, and it feels rather unbelievable that it is finally out. I started small with Evil Robot Traffic Jam HD, a tiny game that was an HD version of an even tinier game. It's not VR (yet), but if you also play non-VR games and enjoy sci-fi ARPGs, my new game could up your alley!

In Reality Break, you're a mercenary who unwittingly becomes imbued with the power to alter reality and finds themselves thrown into a chaotic maelstrom where sinister forces attempt to stop them at every turn.

Use the Rewrite mechanic to change the fundamental nature of the gameplay: resize a weapon to fit your ship, upgrade items to unlock fantastic powers, increase the difficulty, add time to a ticking clock, and more! But do you have what it takes to stop those who know your next move before you even know it yourself?

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Brand new Rewrite mechanic that deeply alters the gameplay on a fundamental level
[*]Diablo-inspired ARPG gameplay with multiple interacting systems for deep build customization
[*]Opt-in roguelite structure inspired by Dead Cells that allows you to reset your timeline and unlock rule-breaking Talents
[*]Tons of loot to collect, try, and modify to suit your needs
[*]An evolving storyline full of mysterious adversaries and shocking secrets that transform the game’s very nature... eventually at your pilot's mystical whim!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473060/Reality_Break/

If you enjoy sci-fi ARPGs, check it out and let me know what you think! Cheers!
~Courtney

notes.title: Our new game Sky Cannoneer just got a big game update!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, ERDF members![/h3]
Last month, we released our PC title Sky Cannoneer, and it has received great reviews from players and streamers already. If you enjoyed the mix of action and strategy in Evil Robot Traffic Jam HD, and you play non-VR games in addition to VR, we're certain you'll enjoy our latest game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141570/Sky_Cannoneer/

[h3]v1.1.0 Update[/h3]
The new update includes many improvements, including two challenging game modes if you're bold enough to check them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25992219/d0238dde341e59db66eb6b54e96002b518fc9f75.gif[/img]

[h3]VR[/h3]
We are taking feedback on our new game to heart, and are working on a VR prototype for the game. In fact, the game began life as a VR testbed, so a lot of it already works in VR. If the game gets a VR mode, we will include it with the Steam version for free.

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
We are also working through bug reports and feature requests for ERTJ HD, and discussing with partners how we could potentially update the game. Thank you for your support, and let us know if you have any questions!
